sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A CLOSED UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO SLOWLY PIVOT OVER NORTHERN PORTIONS OF MANITOBA/ONTARIO...WITH A CYCLONIC BELT OF RELATIVELY STRONG MID-UPPER LEVEL WESTERLIES EXTENDING FROM THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS TO THE GREAT LAKES REGION. MEANWHILE...A SPLIT FLOW REGIME WILL PERSIST OVER THE WESTERN CONUS...WITH A SOUTHERN STREAM UPPER LOW CROSSING NM AS ANOTHER UPPER LOW SLOWLY APPROACHES COASTAL PORTIONS OF ORE/NORTHERN CA.

sections.title: SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS TO OZARKS
sections.text: INITIALLY...A WEAKENING MCS IS LIKELY TO BE ONGOING ACROSS THE OZARKS THIS MORNING...WHILE OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING HELPS TO REESTABLISH AN EFFECTIVE ROUGHLY WSW-ENE FRONTAL ZONE AND AN ASSOCIATED CORRIDOR OF MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY INTO THIS AFTERNOON. A SLOW-MOVING UPPER LOW WILL APPROACH THE REGION FROM THE SOUTHWEST /NM/ AND INFLUENCE WHAT WILL LIKELY BE ANOTHER ROUND OF MCS DEVELOPMENT INTO TONIGHT. INITIALLY...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP/INCREASE WITHIN A SOUTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS CORRIDOR INCLUDING SOUTHEAST CO/NORTHEAST NM INTO SOUTHWEST KS AND THE TX/OK PANHANDLES AND FAR WESTERN OK. WITH THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAVING BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE ALONG/SOUTH OF THE EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE...VEERING WIND PROFILES WILL SUPPORT SOME INITIAL MODE SUPERCELLS/INTENSE MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. AN MCS SEEMS LIKELY TO EVOLVE BY EVENING WITHIN A CORRIDOR ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL OK/SOUTHERN KS VIA A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LOW LEVEL JET AND ASSOCIATED WARM ADVECTION/MOISTURE TRANSPORT REGIME. HEAVY RAIN ASIDE...DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE A CONCERN AS THE COMPLEX GRADUALLY SPREADS EASTWARD TONIGHT.

sections.title: MIDWEST/OH VALLEY/LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: INITIAL FACTOR WILL BE THE POSSIBILITY OF AN ONGOING MCS ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES...ALTHOUGH THE MCS SHOULD ENCOUNTER A RELATIVELY MORE STABLE AIRMASS THIS MORNING AS IT PROGRESSES SOUTHEASTWARD. THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL OTHERWISE CONTINUE TO MOISTEN ACROSS THE REGION AHEAD OF AN UPSTREAM EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING COLD FRONT...ESPECIALLY IN AREAS SOUTH-SOUTHWEST OF THE EARLY DAY MCS AND ASSOCIATED CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE/POTENTIALLY STRONG INSTABILITY SHOULD MATERIALIZE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF IL/INDIANA INTO LOWER MI/OH AHEAD OF THE FRONT...WITH THE STRONGEST VERTICAL SHEAR FOCUSED OVER NORTHERN PORTIONS OF THAT CORRIDOR IN VICINITY OF THE GREAT LAKES. THE PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY IS WHAT MAY BE RELATIVELY MODEST OVERALL FORCING FOR ASCENT/MASS CONVERGENCE NEAR THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT. EVEN SO...SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION/FRONTAL UPLIFT SHOULD ALLOW FOR AT LEAST SOME NEAR-FRONTAL FOCUSED SURFACE BASED CONVECTION...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED BOUTS OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL.

sections.title: TN VALLEY
sections.text: IN THE PRESENCE OF LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE...DAYTIME HEATING WITHIN A MOISTURE RICH/WEAKLY CAPPED BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LIKELY PROMOTE SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS THE TN VALLEY. PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES AND GENERALLY WEAK VEERING FLOW WILL SUPPORT MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED WET MICROBURSTS AND THE POSSIBILITY OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE.

sections.title: NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A POST-FRONTAL LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE REGIME AND SUFFICIENT MOISTURE SHOULD ALLOW FOR ISOLATED/WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS AREAS SUCH AS EASTERN WY INTO WESTERN SD/NEB PANHANDLE. WHILE BUOYANCY WILL BE RELATIVELY MODEST...30-35 KT MID-LEVEL WESTERLIES COMBINED WITH VEERING LOWER TROPOSPHERIC WINDS MAY ALLOW FOR A FEW SUPERCELLS/SUSTAINED MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND.

sections.title: NORTHERN/EAST-CENTRAL MT
sections.text: POSSIBLY AIDED BY A GLANCING SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING MID-LEVEL IMPULSE/SPEED MAX...ISOLATED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN ALBERTA AND NORTH-CENTRAL/EAST-CENTRAL MT THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY MOIST...BUT A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT AND RELATIVELY STRONG WIND PROFILES /ACCENTUATED BY 40+ KT MID-LEVEL WEST-NORTHWESTERLY WINDS/ MAY ALLOW FOR SOME STRONGER/POSSIBLY SEVERE TSTMS CAPABLE OF HAIL/WIND.

sections.title: SOUTHERN ORE/FAR NORTHERN CA
sections.text: A SLOW-MOVING UPPER LOW WILL GRADUALLY SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD AND APPROACH COASTAL PORTIONS OF ORE/NORTHERN CA...WITH DOWNSTREAM HEIGHT FALLS ACROSS ORE/WESTERN GREAT BASIN. ALTHOUGH THE RELATIVE EARLINESS OF THE PRIMARY PIVOTING IMPULSE PROVIDES A BIT OF UNCERTAINTY...FORCING FOR ASCENT/MODEST MOISTURE SHOULD ALLOW FOR THE SUSTENANCE/DEVELOPMENT OF HIGH-BASED TSTMS DURING THE AFTERNOON. GIVEN A WELL-MIXED ENVIRONMENT...LOCALIZED DOWNBURSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. ..GUYER/ROGERS.. 08/07/2013

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH IS FORECAST TO MOVE INTO THE SRN ROCKIES TODAY AS SEVERAL IMPULSES MOVE ENEWD INTO THE SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS. AT THE SFC...A LOW WILL DEEPEN ACROSS NORTHWEST TX AS SFC WINDS BECOME BACKED ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE...SW KS AND NW OK. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F SHOULD ALLOW FOR MODERATE DESTABILIZATION ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON. IN RESPONSE...SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIATE FROM SERN CO EWD ACROSS SRN KS DURING THE MID AFTERNOON WITH CONVECTION EXPANDING IN COVERAGE AND MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT PERRYTON TX AND GAGE OK AT 00Z/THU SHOW MLCAPE IN THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE WITH AROUND 45 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS LATE THIS AFTERNOON ESPECIALLY IF CELLS CAN REMAIN DISCRETE. AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT COULD DEVELOP FROM THE ERN OK PANHANDLE SWD ACROSS THE ERN TX PANHANDLE AND WRN OK WHERE SFC WINDS SHOULD BE SELY HELPING TO ENHANCE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER SHOULD EXTEND EWD FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NE NM EWD ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS WHICH SHOULD HELP LARGE HAIL PRODUCTION. STORM COVERAGE IS FORECAST TO EXPAND M

sections.title: SRN GREAT LAKES/UPPER OH VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE ACROSS THE WRN GREAT LAKES TODAY AS A MID-LEVEL JET NOSES INTO LOWER MI. AT THE SFC...A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE SEWD ACROSS LOWER MI INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY WITH DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE BOUNDARY IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S F. THIS SHOULD ALLOW FOR MODERATE DESTABILIZATION ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION AS SFC TEMPS WARM. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OR LINES OF THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO MOVE SEWD ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA FROM THE MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON...SEE MCD 1654. FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT 21Z FOR DETROIT MI AND CLEVELAND OH SHOW MLCAPE AROUND 1500 J/KG WITH 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL FLOW SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS. AS LAPSE RATES STEEPEN DUE TO SFC HEATING...WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH LINE SEGMENTS THAT ORGANIZE AND PERSIST. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH CELLS THAT CAN OBTAIN ROTATION.

sections.title: TN VALLEY
sections.text: A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS SHOULD BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE TN VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS SHOULD MOVE SEWD FROM THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE TN VALLEY THIS MORNING. AS SFC TEMPS WARM AHEAD OF THE CONVECTION...THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER COMBINED WITH MODERATE DESTABILIZATION SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EVIDENT ON FORECAST SOUNDINGS MAY BE ENOUGH FOR A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL BE FROM THE WEST-NORTHWEST TODAY ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS AS SEVERAL IMPULSES MOVE ACROSS THE REGION. AT THE SFC...WINDS SHOULD BE BACKED TO THE SOUTHEAST ACROSS MUCH OF THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S F. THE MODELS SUGGEST CELLS WILL INITIATE IN NCNTRL MT AND IN ERN WY WITH STORMS MOVING SEWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. IT APPEARS THAT THE COMBINATION OF STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS. HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY IF A POCKET OF MODERATE INSTABILITY CAN DEVELOP ACROSS THE REGION.

sections.title: SW ORE/NRN CA
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL SLOWLY APPROACH THE NRN CA COAST TODAY. AT THE SFC...A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD BE IN PLACE ACROSS NRN CA AND WRN ORE ALONG WHICH POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON. IF CELLS CAN INITIATE ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS WHERE LAPSE RATES WILL BE QUITE STEEP...THEN A MARGINAL THREAT FOR HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS MAY DEVELOP. ..BROYLES/COHEN.. 08/07/2013

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SUPERCELL AND MULTICELL STRUCTURES WITH A HISTORY OF LARGE HAIL SHOULD PERSIST NEAR-TERM INVOF TX/OK/CO/KS BORDER AREA. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS IS POSSIBLE /AS CONSISTENTLY SIMULATED BY RECENT HRRR RUNS/. ALTHOUGH MID/UPPER-LEVEL FLOW IS MODEST...LOW-LEVEL ELYS /AS SAMPLED BY 00Z DDC RAOB/ MAY FOSTER SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR A BOWING SEGMENT GIVEN MLCAPE NEAR 3000 J/KG PER 00Z OUN RAOB. THIS MAY LEAD TO AN INCREASING SEVERE WIND THREAT CENTERED OVER NWRN OK TONIGHT.

sections.title: BLACK HILLS
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREATS WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL AFTER SUNSET GIVEN THE MEAGER BUOYANCY SAMPLED IN THE 00Z RAP RAOB. STILL...MODERATELY STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND MODEST LOW-LEVEL WAA MAY AID IN A STORM CLUSTER PERSISTING WITH MARGINAL SEVERE POTENTIAL INTO THE OVERNIGHT. FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM INFORMATION...PLEASE SEE MCD 1661.

sections.title: MIDWEST
sections.text: WILL MAINTAIN LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES FOR A LOCALIZED SEVERE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT THIS EVENING WITH ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS ALONG A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT. ..GRAMS.. 08/08/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND STRENGTH THROUGH LATER THIS MORNING OVER SRN LWR MI AND NEARBY PORTIONS OF NRN IL...NRN IND...AND NRN OH AS SFC HEATING ERODES NOCTURNAL SFC STABLE LAYER. A WW MAY BE REQUIRED SHORTLY DUE TO ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR DMGG WIND AND SVR HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: GUST FRONT MARKING THE SRN EDGE OF ELONGATING COLD POOL LEFT BY OVERNIGHT SQLN IN WI AND CNTRL MI HAS BECOME ORIENTED ROUGHLY W-E OVER SRN LWR MI...PARALLEL TO SEASONABLY STRONG /30-50 KT/ 700-500 MB FLOW ACROSS REGION. THIS BOUNDARY WILL CONTINUE TO SERVE AS A SOURCE OF LOW-LVL UPLIFT AS IT DRIFTS SLOWLY S ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF LWR MI INTO NRN PARTS OF IL...IND...AND OH LATER THIS MORNING. WITH PARTLY TO MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES PRESENT S OF GUST FRONT...SFC HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN FAIRLY RAPID EROSION OF SFC-BASED NOCTURNAL STABLE LAYER OVER REGION. UPSTREAM 12Z RAOBS AT DVN AND ILX SHOW PRESENCE OF DEEP EML THAT...GIVEN SEASONABLY STRONG WLY FLOW ON SRN FRINGE OF UPR MI VORT MAX...WILL SPREAD RAPIDLY DOWNSTREAM ACROSS SRN LWR MI AND ADJACENT IND/OH THROUGH MIDDAY. COUPLED WITH FAIRLY RICH LOW-LVL MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.50 INCHES/ AND 30-35 KT WLY DEEP SHEAR...SETUP MAY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF CLUSTERS OF SUSTAINED STORMS INCLUDING EMBEDDED ROTATING STRUCTURES/LEWPS CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND AND SVR HAIL. STORM TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...BUT IT APPEARS THAT A WW MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS NRN INTO PARTS OF ERN OH LATE THIS MORNING THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH THE STRONGER...SUSTAINED STORMS...THOUGH UNCERTAINTY REMAINS IN THE POTENTIAL COVERAGE OF A SVR THREAT THAT WOULD WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC TIME-LAPSE INDICATED SCATTERED-NUMEROUS TSTM DEVELOPMENT SINCE 1330-1345Z OVER NRN OH...WITH AT LEAST THE WRN PORTION OF THIS ACTIVITY APPARENTLY DEVELOPING ALONG AND JUST EAST OF A BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM NWRN TO SERN OH. LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION INTO OH COUPLED WITH SURFACE HEATING AND THE ERN EXTENT OF AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR/STEEPER MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IS RESULTING IN MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING INTO CENTRAL OH. MUCH OF THE TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS NRN OH APPEARS TO BE FORCED BY LOW LEVEL ISENTROPIC ASCENT PER 15-20 KT SWLY FLOW INTO CENTRAL/NRN OH. FURTHER DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR AS FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO AN MCV OR MIDLEVEL IMPULSE WITH THE SRN LOWER MI TSTM CLUSTER PROGRESSES ESEWD TODAY. THE AVAILABLE INSTABILITY AND STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AS A 50 KT WLY MIDLEVEL JET SPREADS EWD SUGGEST AT LEAST A FEW STRONGER TO SVR STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THE AFTERNOON. DOWNSTREAM CLOUDINESS PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INTO MUCH OF EAST CENTRAL-NERN OH SHOULD TEND TO TEMPER SURFACE HEATING AND SLOW THE REMOVAL OF SURFACE BASED INHIBITION. THIS LATTER FACTOR APPEARS TO BE A PRIMARY LIMIT FOR GREATER COVERAGE OF STRONG-SVR STORMS...AND THUS PRECLUDES THE ISSUANCE OF A WW AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND AFFECT PARTS OF CENTRAL TO NERN IL...FAR SRN LAKE MICHIGAN...FAR NRN IND...AND POTENTIALLY THROUGH PORTION OF SRN LOWER MI AND NWRN OH THIS AFTERNOON. A FEW STRONGER STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH SOME BECOMING SEVERE WITH HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS. CURRENT FORECAST THINKING EXPECTS THE COVERAGE OF THE STRONGER/SVR THREAT TO REMAIN TOO LOW TO WARRANT THE ISSUANCE OF A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE ANALYSES SHOWED A COLD FRONT CONTINUING TO ADVANCE THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES REGION...AND AT 18Z THIS BOUNDARY EXTENDED SWWD THROUGH NRN LAKE HURON TO NERN INTO SWRN LOWER MI...INTO NERN IL /NORTH OF CHICAGO/ AND ACROSS NRN IL. ALTHOUGH A COUPLE OF STORMS WERE LOCATED ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN FAR NERN IL...THE REST OF THE STORMS THAT HAVE DEVELOPED SO FAR ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA TEND TO BE INVOF OF A PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT. MODELS SUGGEST AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES CONFIRM THAT STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT NEWD AWAY FROM THE WARM SECTOR...WITH A GRADUAL RISE IN HEIGHTS...WARMING MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES AND WEAKENING WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS. WHILE THE TRENDS IN THESE FACTORS SHOULD LIMIT THE OVERALL COVERAGE OF STRONGER TO SEVERE STORMS...A RESIDUAL MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT SOUTH OF THE COLD FRONT AND SUFFICIENT BULK SHEAR SUGGEST SPORADIC UPSCALE GROWTH WILL BE POSSIBLE. THUS...AN ISOLATED THREAT EXISTS FOR HAIL AROUND 1 INCH IN DIAMETER AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGER STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON IF STORMS TREND TOWARD CONSOLIDATION AND GREATER UPSCALE GROWTH. OTHERWISE...THE STRONGER...SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A THREAT FOR MAINLY HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID AFTERNOON MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BROKEN BAND OF TSTMS...A FEW BECOMING STRONGER TO SEVERE AT TIMES...ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A MODESTLY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM PROGRESSING ESEWD THROUGH ERN OH AND WRN PA. ALTHOUGH IR SATELLITE IMAGERY DID NOT INDICATE RAPID COOLING WITH THESE STORMS AND WDSS-II 9 KM CAPPI IMAGERY SHOWED ONLY A FEW SUSTAINED/STRONGER UPDRAFTS IN CENTRAL/ERN OH...A RATHER MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS HAS DEVELOPED ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE CURRENT STORMS. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A PROGRESSIVE MCV...NOW MOVING INTO NERN OH...PER RADAR IMAGERY MAY CONTINUE TO PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR ADDITIONAL STORMS...IN ADDITION TO ASCENT/LIFT ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE MCS INTO THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR UP TO 35-40 KT IS MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR ADDITIONAL STORM ORGANIZATION WITH THE SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY ACROSS PORTIONS OF NORTHEAST NEW MEXICO AND SOUTHEAST COLORADO OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORMS. ADDITIONALLY...A MORE CONDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM THREAT MAY ALSO DEVELOP/EVOLVE INTO PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST KANSAS AND THE OKLAHOMA/TEXAS PANHANDLES. THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THESE THUNDERSTORMS WOULD BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE CURRENTLY ONGOING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE ROCKY MOUNTAINS ACROSS PORTIONS OF NORTHEASTERN NEW MEXICO AND SOUTHEASTERN COLORADO. OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP /SOUTHEAST OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION/ IN AN AREA EXTENDING FROM NORTHWEST OF TUCUMCARI /NEW MEXICO/ SOUTHEAST TO NORTH OF PLAINVIEW /TEXAS/. ALTHOUGH THE ENVIRONMENT IN THIS AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY MODEST INSTABILITY /MLCAPE VALUES 500-1000 J/KG/...DEEP LAYER SHEAR APPEARS RATHER LIMITED /LESS THAN 30 KTS/ SUGGESTING MULTI-CELL THUNDERSTORMS AS THE FAVORED MODE MODE. AN ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL OR DAMAGING WIND GUST WOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH ANY THUNDERSTORMS. WITH TIME...THESE MORE ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO ONE OR MORE EAST/NORTHEASTWARD ADVANCING COMPLEXES. A MORE FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE CONVECTION EXISTS ACROSS SOUTHERN KANSAS AND THE TEXAS PANHANDLE. THE ENVIRONMENT HERE IS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE VALUES AT OR ABOVE 1000 J/KG AND 30-40 KTS OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR. ANY THUNDERSTORM/COMPLEX OF THUNDERSTORMS THAT CAN MOVE INTO THIS ENVIRONMENT WOULD POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. IF CONFIDENCE IN THIS SCENARIO INCREASES...A WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY LATER THIS EVENING

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT MAY SPREAD DOWNSTREAM FROM WW 482...AND AFFECT PORTIONS OF CNTRL PA...NRN MD...FAR ERN WV...AND EXTREME NRN VA THIS EVENING. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE MOVING E AT 25 KT ACROSS WRN PA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER IS LOCATED DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS ACTIVITY OVER CNTRL PA. HOWEVER...TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 70S TO LOW 80S COMBINED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S IS AIDING IN MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES UP TO 1500 J/KG. THIS THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COMBINED WITH 35 KT OF MIDLEVEL WLY FLOW WILL SUPPORT STORM MAINTENANCE AND A CONTINUED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT GOING INTO THE EVENING. THUS...A NEW WW MAY NEED TO BE ISSUED E OF WW 482 DURING THE NEXT HOUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL BE POSSIBLE OVER ERN WY...SWRN SD...WRN NEB...AND FAR NERN CO LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. A WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY ATTM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MESOANALYSIS AT 22Z SHOWS AN AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE CENTERED OVER CNTRL WY...WITH SELY UPSLOPE FLOW AND A THETA-E AXIS /WHERE TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S ARE COLLOCATED WITH DEWPOINTS FROM 50-60F/ LOCATED ESEWD FROM THE LOW INTO ERN WY AND THE NEB PANHANDLE. IN ADDITION...SEVERAL UPPER IMPULSES WERE OBSERVED IN WV IMAGERY...ONE MOVING NWD OVER ERN CO...AND A SECOND MOVING EWD OVER NRN WY. COMBINATION OF WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY...THE UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME...AND PERHAPS MODEST UPPER SUPPORT ASSOCIATED WITH PREVIOUSLY MENTIONED IMPULSES WILL AID IN AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. SELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS VEER TO WLY IN THE MIDLEVELS...WHICH IS SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS INITIALLY...POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL. AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES...LOW-LEVEL SLY JET WILL STRENGTHEN AND AID IN UPSCALE GROWTH AS STORMS SPREAD EWD ACROSS SWRN SD AND WRN NEB. THIS MAY SUPPORT AN INCREASED POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS...IN ADDITION TO HEAVY RAIN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF STORMS FROM NERN WY INTO SWRN SD WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL THIS EVENING. UPSCALE GROWTH MAY TAKE PLACE AFTER DARK AS LLJ STRENGTHENS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EVENING MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A WEAK BAROCLINIC/CONVERGENCE ZONE EXTENDING SWWD FROM CNTRL SD INTO SWRN SD...AND THEN NWWD INTO FAR SERN MT. ASCENT FOCUSED INVOF THIS FEATURE...COMBINED WITH POSSIBLE UPPER SUPPORT ASSOCIATED WITH AN IMPULSE MOVING E ACROSS NRN WY...HAS YIELDED SCATTERED STORM CLUSTERS FROM NERN WY INTO SWRN SD. THE 00Z RAOBS FROM RAP AND LBF SHOW THE PRESENCE OF MODERATELY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ABOVE A WARM BUT SOMEWHAT DRY BOUNDARY LAYER THAT SUPPORTS MUCAPE VALUES NEAR 1000 J/KG WHERE SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 50S. THIS THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COMBINED WITH SUPERCELL SHEAR PROFILES WILL FAVOR A LARGE HAIL THREAT DURING THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. AFTER DARK...ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO MERGE AND GROW UPSCALE AS 25-30 KT SLY LLJ DEVELOPS OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. THREAT MAY TRANSITION TO ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND LOCALLY HEAVY RAIN AS THIS TAKES PLACE. ..GARNER.. 08/08/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHORT-TERM THREAT FOR SUPERCELLS AND VERY LARGE HAIL CONTINUES INVOF THE OK PANHANDLE THIS EVENING. ELSEWHERE...MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND LINE SEGMENTS ARE EVOLVING OVER SERN CO/SWRN KS...AS WELL AS THE TX PANHANDLE...AND WILL ALSO POSE A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EVENING MESOANALYSIS SHOWS AN AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE SITUATED OVER WRN TX...WITH A WEAK RIDGE OF HIGH PRESSURE FROM CNTRL CO INTO NERN NEB. AS A RESULT...PRONOUNCED ZONE OF ELY FLOW OVER THE LOWEST 1-2 KM AGL IS FOCUSED OVER WW 483. IN ADDITION...00Z RAOBS FROM DDC AND OUN ARE CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATELY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND A WARM/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER THAT IS SUPPORTING MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-3000 J/KG. THE MOIST/UNSTABLE ELY INFLOW IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN STORMS AFTER DARK...AND POSSIBLY SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS FROM THE ERN TX PANHANDLE INTO SWRN KS LATER TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. ..GARNER.. 08/08/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL LINE SEGMENT OVER THE OK PANHANDLE HAS BEGUN TO ACCELERATE EWD...AND MAY EXIT WW 483 DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. IF THIS OCCURS...THEN THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL INCREASE OVER NWRN OK INTO SWRN/S-CNTRL KS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR LIKELY WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS DISCUSSED IN MCD 1662...THE COMBINATION OF ELY WINDS IN THE 1-2 KM AGL LAYER AND A VERY MOIST AND MODERATELY/STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS TONIGHT. LATEST COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS SIGNS OF THIS TAKING PLACE OVER THE OK PANHANDLE...WHERE A SMALL LINE SEGMENT HAS INCREASED ITS EWD MOTION TO 30 KT. GIVEN THIS TREND...ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW IS LIKELY FOR PORTIONS OF NWRN OK AND SWRN/S-CNTRL KS DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY ISOLATED TONIGHT OVER NERN WY...SWRN SD...AND NWRN NEB. THOUGH SOME POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE MAY PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS...MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT SHOULD JUSTIFY WW EXPIRATION AT 05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 04Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONG/OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORMS MOVING SEWD ACROSS WW 484. ONE CLUSTER WAS LOCATED OVER NERN WY...A SECOND WAS ENTERING NWRN NEB...AND A THIRD WAS OBSERVED OVER HAAKON AND JONES COUNTIES. BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO STABILIZE WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...WHICH IS RESULTING IN A QUICK REDUCTION IN POTENTIAL INSTABILITY. THOUGH EFFECTIVE SHEAR RANGES FROM 30-40 KT...LACK OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT AND DECREASING INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED TO PROMOTE A GENERAL WEAKENING TREND IN ONGOING STORMS AND THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. ..GARNER.. 08/08/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SHORT-TERM SEVERE WEATHER THREAT EXISTS OVER THE ERN OK/TX PANHANDLES...AS WELL AS PORTIONS OF SWRN KS LOCATED ADJACENT TO THE OK BORDER. THREAT SHOULD BE MORE ISOLATED IN NATURE OVER WRN KS DUE TO STABILIZING EFFECTS OF WIDESPREAD STRATIFORM RAINFALL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AT 04Z INDICATE TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE LOW 80S OVER FAR ERN PORTIONS OF THE OK/TX PANHANDLES...AND WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S TO LOW 70S...HIGH THETA-E AIRMASS WITH MLCAPE VALUES AOA 1500 J/KG PERSISTS. IN ADDITION...ELY WINDS IN THE LOWEST 1-2 KM AGL ARE AIDING IN MCS MAINTENANCE AND DOWNSHEAR PROPAGATION AT 30-40 KT. SMALL BOW ECHO HAS FORMED AS A RESULT...AND WILL POSE THE GREATEST THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS ACROSS WW 483. STORMS MAY LINGER WITHIN THE WATCH OVER OK/TX PAST THE 05Z EXPIRATION...WHICH COULD REQUIRE AN EXTENSION IN TIME BY WFO/S. FARTHER N OVER PORTIONS OF WRN KS...COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A SMALL LINE OF HIGHER REFLECTIVITY EMBEDDED WITHIN STRATIFORM RAINFALL. BOUNDARY LAYER AIRMASS IS COOLER AS A RESULT...WHICH WILL LIKELY HINDER A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. WW 483 CAN PROBABLY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE ON TIME FOR THESE LOCATIONS. ..GARNER.. 08/08/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE COULD BECOME NECESSARY DOWNSTREAM FROM WW 485 IF THE LINE CAN REMAIN ORGANIZED EARLY THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BOWING LINE-SEGMENT FROM NEAR PRATT KS SSEWD TO NEAR ENID OK IS LOCATED ALONG A GRADIENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING EWD ACROSS NRN OK. AHEAD OF THE LINE...SBCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE ACROSS MUCH OF SCNTRL AND SERN KS. IN ADDITION...THE LINE IS BEING SUPPORTED BY THE EXIT REGION OF A JET NEAR 700 MB. AS THE LINE MOVES NEWD...SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S F ALONG WITH 30-35 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS...COULD BE ENOUGH FOR A CONTINUED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. A FEW STORMS COULD ALSO BECOME SEVERE EWD ACROSS NERN OK TO NEAR THE MO-AR STATE-LINE WHERE WARM AIR ADVECTION IS STRONG AND MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ALSO PRESENT.
